Winning Ticket has been working hard on 
weight-loss training for her diet, but...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Just gaining a little weight... and I can 
barely run anymore... ughhh...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I-I've... already lost the power I had to 
run at full throttle back thennn~~~...!!

text_block_list.text:

got...!! And take it back...!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
U... Uwooooohhhh!!! This much weight is 
nothin' to meee...!!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Compared to getting back to full 
power...!!! This feels like nothing at 
aaaaalll!!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"Come on... me!!! Don't you give up!!! 
Come on, meeeeeee!!!"

After running non-stop without looking 
back, Winning Ticket successfully lost the 
weight...!
